_comment: One entry per repository. kind: meta | tooling | template | driver | core | hal | docs. required_checks overrides policy.default_required_checks; [] means no required check yet.

.github.description: Kokeb Labs organization profile, community files, settings as code and the engineering standard.

ci-tools.description: Reusable GitHub Actions workflows, lint configs and the documentation theme for Kokeb Labs repositories.

espidf-tools.description: Build, flash and setup scripts for ESP-IDF projects and examples.

driver-template.description: Start a new chip driver or library: one command gives code, host tests, an ESP32 example, docs and CI.

driver-ads7952.description: C++20 driver for the TI ADS7950/51/52/53 12-bit 4/8/12/16-channel SPI ADCs

driver-as5047u.description: C++20 driver for the ams OSRAM AS5047U 14-bit magnetic rotary position sensor (SPI)

driver-at25040b.description: C++20 driver for the Microchip AT25010B/020B/040B SPI serial EEPROMs

driver-max22200.description: C++20 driver for the Analog Devices MAX22200 octal solenoid and motor driver (SPI)

driver-pcal9555.description: C++20 driver for the NXP PCA9555 and PCAL9555A 16-bit I2C GPIO expanders

driver-tle92466ed.description: C++20 driver for the Infineon TLE92466ED six-channel low-side solenoid driver (SPI)

kokeb-labs.github.io.description: The Kokeb Labs portal: projects, how we build, roadmap and contributing.
